messages:
Noah: Quick sync 18 - dropping new roles panel mocks. Main goal: reduce initial scan time for admins landing on Org Settings.

Maya: Looked through them. Two hotspots: the legend is visually heavy when there are many roles, and the SSO toggle block pushes content down because of verbose help text.

Oliver: Agree. For the legend, could we compress long descriptions into a short pill and reveal details on demand?

Hana: Accessibility flag: hover-only reveals won't work. Any on-demand detail must be keyboard-expandable with clear aria-expanded state and visible focus styles. Also check color contrast on pills (aim >= 4.5).

Maya: Proposed pattern: pill shows role name + short badge. A small chevron button expands an inline details region. Chevrons are real buttons with aria-controls.

Sam: From an implementation POV: inline expanders should lazy-render content for large orgs and animate height to reduce layout shift. We'll need to coordinate focus timing so keyboard focus doesn't get lost mid-animation.

Oliver: I'll update the mock to include two options: 1) inline expandable rows with chevrons, 2) alternate side-panel that opens the role detail (less layout shift, slightly farther from the list).

Noah: On SSO copy: current help text feels technical. Maya suggested: "Require single sign-on for this org (recommended for security-conscious teams)". I want something shorter: "Enforce SSO for everyone 18 recommended." Then a small tertiary link: "Why this matters" opens a modal.

Hana: Modal requirements: focus trap, descriptive heading, programmatic focus to the modal title (tabindex=-1), Esc to close. Also mention audit log behavior in the modal: where enforcement events appear.

Oliver: Where to link to the audit? There's already a toolbar audit link but users said they couldn't find SSO events. Suggest adding a quick-filter CTA next to the toggle: "View SSO events" which deep-links to the audit with a pre-applied filter.

Sam: Backend already tags events with event_type: sso.enforce. Frontend deep-link would be: /orgs/:id/audit?filter=event_type%3Asso.enforce (URL-encoded). I'll implement.

Maya: UX flow: when SSO is toggled ON we show a confirmation/rollout panel. That panel needs to receive focus when it opens, and the primary CTA should read "Start SSO rollout" (explicit).

Hana: Make the confirmation title an h2 with tabindex=-1 and focus it after expand animation. Ensure the CTA buttons have accessible labels and tooltips are not the only source of information.

Noah: Also, ensure tab order doesn't jump into the densest part of the legend after the panel opens. Tabbing sequence should be: panel title -> primary CTA -> secondary CTA -> back to the rest.

Oliver: I'll include keyboard states and a motion spec (160ms animation) with a note to call focus after animationend. I'll also prototype the side-panel version to compare discoverability.

Sam: Engineering note: lazy render + animate + focus call is straightforward; we should debounce focus if users rapidly toggle. Also add aria-live region for success/failure messages after rollout starts.

Maya: I'll run a 5-person usability run next week. Key metrics: time-to-find SSO events, success reading role details, and perceived clarity of the SSO copy.

design-bot: Mock uploaded: https://figma.redwood.com/file/abc123/roles-compact-pills - comments enabled.

Oliver: Draft modal header: "Why enforcing SSO matters". First sentence: "Enforcing SSO reduces the risk of credential-based takeover and centralizes access control."

Hana: Add to modal body: "Audit logs will record enforcement events under \"sso.enforce\". Use the 'View SSO events' quick-filter to inspect recent activity."

Noah: Action items: Oliver 18 update mocks (inline + side-panel); Hana 18 accessibility checklist for expanders/tooltips/modal; Sam 18 deep-link + focus handling prototype; Maya 18 schedule 5 tests and share script. I'll follow up after the tests.

Maya: Quick copy ask: keep modal blurbs to one-liners and a 1-line summary at the top. Drop longer paragraphs.

Sam: Prototyping focus behavior today; will post a short recording.

Noah: Closing: confirm deep-link uses URL-encoded filter, confirmation panel supports Esc to dismiss, and both toolbar + inline "View SSO events" land to the same filtered audit view. :thumbsup:
